title: Everyday Tenses Mix
description: A starter set mixing present, past, and future forms.

wrong_answer_notes.drank: This is past simple, not present.
wrong_answer_notes.is drinking: Present continuous is not used for habits.

wrong_answer_notes.go: Past simple needs the past form.
wrong_answer_notes.gone: Past participle is used with have/has.
wrong_answer_notes.are going: Present continuous does not match past time marker.

wrong_answer_notes.was: Past tense does not fit future prediction.

questions.question: Look! The kids ____ outside.

wrong_answer_notes.plays: Third-person singular is not correct for plural subject.
wrong_answer_notes.played: Past simple does not match the current action.

questions.question_note: Use present continuous for actions happening now.

wrong_answer_notes.had: Past perfect needs a past reference point.
wrong_answer_notes.were: This is a past form of be, not an auxiliary.

questions.question: By the time she arrived, we ____ eaten.

wrong_answer_notes.have: Past perfect uses had for all subjects.
wrong_answer_notes.has: Has is present perfect, not past perfect.

questions.question_note: Past perfect shows an earlier past action.
